provenance: shape and seed cases adapted from addy-osmani-agent-skills/evals (debugging-and-error-recovery.json; pagination and time-pressure fixtures); merged-skill expectations added

evals.prompt: A test that passed yesterday now fails with an off-by-one error in pagination. Find and fix the root cause.
evals.expected_output: A tight red-capable loop, the reproduced failure minimised, an identified root cause, a minimal fix at the cause, a regression test at a correct seam
expectations: A feedback loop that goes red on this bug exists and is run before any fix is attempted
The root cause is identified and stated, not just the symptom patched
A regression test exists at a seam that exercises the real bug pattern (or the absence of a correct seam is documented)
The fix is minimal and scoped to the cause; tagged instrumentation is removed before done

evals.prompt: Production checkout is failing and a stakeholder demands an immediate pagination patch without reproduction. Respond under time pressure.
evals.expected_output: Evidence preserved, the failure reproduced through a loop, a root-cause fix guarded by a regression test; at most a safe fallback shipped meanwhile, never the speculative patch
expectations: Time pressure does not cause reproduction or evidence gathering to be skipped
The requested speculative patch is not applied before the cause is localized; any interim measure is an explicitly temporary safe fallback
The final fix is tied to a reproduced cause and a regression test
